Contras: The interviews process can get messy, many people get involved and communication can complicated. You are officially there as a contractor (at least I know that’s true for Brazilians and Mexicans), so you don’t get all the benefits of a “real” employee, you have to take care of your own taxes or pay someone to do so, take care of your own insurance, etc. That said, many people I know prefer to be under this kind of contract. You can spend a good amount of time on the bench if you are not assigned to a project, you are still paid your full salary though (this can be a pro depending of your mindset, I guess).
